gusts up to 45 kt and seas 8 to 12 ft. For the Small Craft
Advisory, northeast winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and
seas 6 to 9 ft expected.

* WHERE...Waters from Pensacola FL to Pascagoula MS from 20 to

capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.

expected. For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves
building to 8 to 12 feet.

* WHERE...Southeast Georgia and Northeast Florida Beaches.

* WHEN...For the High Rip Current Risk, from 6 AM EDT this
